goal: Implement frontend lane for redirecting demo: Phase 1 dual-entry Streamlit loop (Plan Start and Focus Now) with rerun-safe flow, then Phase 2 reflection evidence curation and 3-tier weekly replay UI within streamlit limits.

constraints.notes: Use st.form submission boundaries and minimize st.rerun churn. Do not re-enable Gap/Entropy UX in demo mode.

acceptance: Phase 1 provides a single demo-safe path: Focus start/end and Reflection save with dual-entry CTA visible at home.
Input loss and excessive rerun regression are mitigated with explicit state-key minimization and form-bound submits.
Phase 2 provides reflection evidence curation (1-2 images + meaning/skip) and 3-tier weekly replay representation.
Frontend lane publishes schema-valid result with reproducible demo scenario evidence.

risk.note: Streamlit rerun pressure can degrade perceived quality; scope must stay on deterministic demo loops.

next_actions: Implement and demo-proof Phase 1 UX loop and buffering mitigation first.
Publish Phase 1 scenario evidence (focus-first and plan-first paths).
Implement constrained Phase 2 replay/curation UI and publish evidence.
